description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyIdNotExplicitlySettableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, and provides builder methods for creating instances with specific details. The class is annotated with @JsonParsableException and @Immutable, and it includes nested builder class annotated with @NotThreadSafe.
